rules: The offline view is OOF only, materialized under fold protocol AFAC_A2_FOLD_V1 with an explicit user order.
Test scores are never accepted as OOF and never enter the offline evaluation view.
The online champion record (score 0.5093) is an identity/deployment record only; it is never usable as an offline OOF artifact.
Assets are never selected by mtime, recency, or guessed file names; only explicit, hash-verified assets qualify.
If no explicit asset qualifies, the view status is waiting_for_explicit_asset and names the single missing asset.
transfer_policy: No A2 user ids, item ids, scores, checkpoints, or weights may be migrated into B2; only portable principles transfer.
